title: Snake
description: Eat dots, grow longer and avoid the walls and your own tail.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic three-in-a-row. You are X; the computer plays O.
Combine matching tiles to reach 2048. Swipe or use arrow keys.

title: Minesweeper
description: Clear safe squares without triggering a mine.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip cards and match every pair in as few moves as possible.

title: Pong
description: Beat the computer by returning the ball and scoring points.

title: Breakout
description: Bounce the ball, break the bricks and clear the board.

title: Sky Hop
description: Tap to fly through the gaps.

title: Word Guess
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries.

title: Connect Four
description: Drop four pieces in a row before the computer does.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Pick a move and challenge the computer.

title: Number Guess
description: Find the secret number between 1 and 100.

title: Whack-a-Mole
description: Tap the target before the timer ends.

title: Reaction Test
description: Wait for the signal, then tap as fast as you can.

title: Sliding Puzzle
description: Arrange 1–15 with the empty space in the bottom-right.

title: Endless Runner
description: Jump over obstacles and survive as long as possible.
